blocks.text: Gene expression ki regulation ki ahmiyat

Gene expression ki regulation se cells mahol ke halaat ke mutabiq jawab de sakte hain aur zaroorat ke waqt protein bana sakte hain. Multicellular (bohat se cells wale) jandaron mein gene regulation cellular differentiation (cells ka mukhtalif qismon mein dhalna) aur morphogenesis (jism ki shakal banna) ki bunyad hai. Isi se mukhtalif qisam ke cells bante hain: har cell mein genome aik hi hai, lekin har qisam ke cell mein us ke mutabiq alag genes express hote hain.
